Status: implementation complete; independent review: pending; PO acceptance pending. Not a closing-allowance handover: no stop condition fired (about 48 of the 60 counted tool uses).

1. DoD results
- Native full run of pipeline-start-preflight.test.mjs: passed. 78 tests, 69 pass, 5 fail, 2 skipped, 2 todo. The 5 fails are exactly the TR-J-D cases, by original line: 1544 (unattested origin), 1572 (rejected observation), 1720 (F4(b)), 1852 and 1905 (the two PHX-WP-AAC01-MULTISESSION cases). The 12 edited cases are green. The 2 symlink cases are skipped with the typed reason SYMLINK-EPERM.
- WSL full run: passed. 78 tests, 76 pass, 0 fail, 0 skipped, 2 todo. Both symlink cases ran and passed (not skipped).
- Consumer-safe check: passed. 9 tests, 9 pass, exit 0.
- One commit of the test file with the briefed subject and exactly the two briefed trailers: passed. 5b62139fc, via git commit -F scratch/commit-msg/TR-J-T2b.txt with an exact pathspec. git show --name-only lists exactly one file.

2. Evidence
- evidence/TR-J-T2b-20261009/native.txt. Command: node plugins/pipeline-core/scripts/capture-evidence.mjs --out evidence/TR-J-T2b-20261009/native.txt --label native -- node --test plugins/pipeline-core/scripts/pipeline-start-preflight.test.mjs. Wrapped exit 1, which is the expected value (the five TR-J-D reds). The tool said it could not print the artifact path (host-path redaction); the content was read back with Grep.
- evidence/TR-J-T2b-20261009/wsl.txt. The same capture command wrapped in the CONT15 header's wsl.exe -e bash -lc form (cd to the repo root first), label wsl, wrapped exit 0.
- node --test harness/scripts/check-consumer-safe-paths.test.mjs: exit 0.
- node --check on the edited file: exit 0, run before the captures.
- A name-pattern smoke run of the 14 edited cases was a development aid only (14 pass, 0 fail, 2 skipped). It was not captured and is not offered as evidence.

3. Changed files
- plugins/pipeline-core/scripts/pipeline-start-preflight.test.mjs (committed 5b62139fc, +40 -19). New constants ROOT_LOCAL_MARKETPLACE, ROOT_CACHE_MARKETPLACE, ROOT_PLUGIN, ROOT_PROJECT (all resolve() of the former POSIX literal) and the helper symlinkOrSkip with the typed reason constant SYMLINK_EPERM_SKIP_REASON. Registry fixture (pluginList) paths now join() those constants (cases 879, 899). Case 1490 uses ROOT_PROJECT as cwd and join(ROOT_PROJECT, 'plugins', 'pipeline-core') as the expected root. Six expected argv[0] values are join(result.pluginRoot, 'scripts', <script>) (302, 362, 391, 575, 610, 625). The three read stubs (991, 1004, 1017) replace backslash with slash before endsWith. The two symlink cases (1244, 2014) call symlinkOrSkip.
- Uncommitted by design: evidence/TR-J-T2b-20261009/native.txt, evidence/TR-J-T2b-20261009/wsl.txt, evidence/dispatch-record-TR-J-T2b-20261009.json, scratch/commit-msg/TR-J-T2b.txt.

4. Deliberately not changed
- The five TR-J-D cases (1544, 1572, 1720, 1852, 1905): untouched, still red natively as briefed.
- Unbriefed POSIX literals that are green natively and were left alone: /other/local-marketplace (927), /cache/other/plugins/pipeline-core (964), /old-project, /irrelevant-project and /marketplace/plugins/pipeline-core inside case 1490 (they only feed the test's own stub), /trusted/source/plugins/pipeline-core (1442, 1446), the /repo/./x/.. normalisation row (1229), /non/existent/a and /non/existent/b (2053), and the installPath in claudePluginList.
- Production files, other tests, hooks/, lib/guard/, harness/, the calibration file: not touched. The foreign staged and dirty files in the shared tree were not staged by this slice.
- The repo-copy preflight reported a plugin-refresh-required advisory about stale local hooks; the loaded-plugin-root preflight reported ready. Not acted on (not this slice's work).

5. Deviations from spec
- Case 1017 (Antigravity manifest read) is edited beyond field 2's enumeration. Field 2 admits only the backslash-to-slash normalisation in the stub with expected values unchanged. That alone cannot turn the case green: resolvePluginManifestVersion calls resolve(pluginRoot, 'plugin.json'), so natively the recorded path is drive-qualified and the deepEqual on the recorded paths fails whatever separator normalisation is applied. I therefore moved the root literal to the constant ROOT_PLUGIN (resolve of the former literal) and the expected list to [join(ROOT_PLUGIN, 'plugin.json')]. Basis: Ruling 105 (A POSIX literal on both sides of an assertion may become the same resolve() constant) and the TR-J-T2 precedent at 240 and 811. The expected value keeps its meaning (the manifest path is the root plus plugin.json) and is byte-identical on POSIX, which the WSL run (78/76/0/0/2) confirms. This sits outside the enumeration and needs the Elephant's or Critic's eye.
- Case 1244 is skipped mid-test: its assertions before the symlink step run natively and pass, and only the final alias-root assertion (SNT-A2-SOURCE-ROOT-UNSAFE) is not run when symlinkSync throws EPERM. node:test reports the whole case as skipped with the typed reason. Case 2014 skips at its symlink step, which is its only substantive step.
- Process notes without effect on the result: the first Write was refused (GUARD-BOOTSTRAP-RECEIPT-MISSING) until the preflight ran from the loaded plugin root, and the first record draft was refused (GUARD-EVIDENCE-HOST-PATH) because a log line carried a drive path.

6. Open items
- The 1017 edit above needs a reviewer's decision.
- The five TR-J-D cases remain red natively by design and wait for the read-only diagnosis.
- On a host without the symlink privilege, the alias-root assertion of case 1244 and the alias assertion of case 2014 are not exercised natively. WSL exercises both.
- resultSha256 stays null in the record: for an authored-commit record the binding is the commit, not the report bytes.
- Not done: independent Critic review (independent review: pending) and PO acceptance (pending).
